title: Set the discounts every bid starts with

steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: Decide once which discounts your estimates offer, so every bid starts the same way.

steps.caption: Bid discounts
steps.narration: In Settings, scroll down to Bid discounts.

steps.caption: Built-in offers
steps.narration: Four offers are built in. Each one shows its percent, and what the client must do to get it.

steps.caption: Switch one on
steps.narration: Switch on the ones you give. Each change is saved right away.

steps.caption: Your own offer
steps.narration: To add your own offer, type its name.

steps.caption: Conditions
steps.narration: And, if you like, what qualifies.

steps.caption: Your offer is in the list
steps.narration: Your offer joins the list, already switched on. The bin beside it removes it.

steps.caption: What happens next
steps.narration: From now on, new estimates start with these offers when you send them.

steps.caption: One estimate can differ
steps.narration: The Discounts button on a single estimate can still change them for that one bid.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Bid discounts are in Settings, near the bottom of the left menu.

youtube.title: How to set default discounts for every estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Set your standard discount offers once in the ConstructHUB CRM. Switch the built-in offers on or off, add your own with a percent and a condition, and every new estimate starts with them when it is sent. Recorded in a demo workspace.
